subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ and column ‘B’ to write five complete sentence.
stimulus: There are more parts of sentences in column ‘B’ than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B a. Newspaper is i. games and sports etc. b. The newspaper plays ii. the people’s parliament. c. It is said to be the iii. an important role in modern civilization. d. It helps us in acquiring iv. facts and problems e. The newspaper is a v. general knowledge. vi. dainty in a dish of varieties. vii. mirror of the world.
guide_solution: (a + ii) : Newspaper is the people’s parliament. (b +iii) : The newspaper plays an important role in modern civilization. (c + vii) : It is said to be the mirror of the world. (d + v) : It helps us in acquiring general knowledge. (e + vi) : The newspaper is a dainty in a dish of varieties.
